summary.en: The pedalboard is bigger than the living room. Fuzz and delay get stomped for an hour.
summary.zh: 效果器板比客厅大。Fuzz 和 Delay 踩一小时。

body.en:
The name stuck because guitarists stare at the floor—at racks of pedals—while walls of reverb and fuzz bury the vocal.

My Bloody Valentine and Slowdive made the joke true: gaze at shoes, flood the room, leave the stage banter to other genres.
body.zh:
名字能站住，是因为吉他手盯地板——盯那一排单块——混响和 fuzz 把人声埋进去。

My Bloody Valentine 和 Slowdive 把笑话坐实：盯鞋、灌满房间、把台上废话留给别的流派。

note.en: Delay/reverb stacks, whispered vocals, shoes optional but on-brand.
note.zh: Delay/混响堆栈、气声人声；鞋可选，但很符合人设。
